name: Sea Crochet Tutu Dress
description: A sea-themed tutu dress with a crochet body, knee length dress design. Starfish and flower details sit at the waist, above a flowing turquoise net tutu skirt.
description2: The net skirt is layered for volume and lined with soft cotton underneath, so it stays comfortable while keeping its full, bouncy shape.

specs.fabric: Crochet body with a layered net tutu skirt
specs.fit: Fitted crochet body with a flared, twirl-friendly tutu skirt
